hebrewText: וַ/יֹּ֤אמֶר לָ/הֶם֙ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ עִ֠בְרוּ לִ/פְנֵ֨י אֲר֧וֹן יְהוָ֛ה אֱלֹֽהֵי/כֶ֖ם אֶל תּ֣וֹךְ הַ/יַּרְדֵּ֑ן וְ/הָרִ֨ימוּ לָ/כֶ֜ם אִ֣ישׁ אֶ֤בֶן אַחַת֙ עַל שִׁכְמ֔/וֹ לְ/מִסְפַּ֖ר שִׁבְטֵ֥י בְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵֽל

tokens.bdb: to say (used with great latitude)
tokens.kjv: answer, appoint, avouch, bid, boast self, call, certify, challenge, charge, [phrase] (at the, give) command(-ment), commune, consider, declare, demand, [idiom] desire, determine, [idiom] expressly, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] intend, name, [idiom] plainly, promise, publish, report, require, say, speak (against, of), [idiom] still, [idiom] suppose, talk, tell, term, [idiom] that is, [idiom] think, use (speech), utter, [idiom] verily, [idiom] yet.
tokens.explanation: amar — dizer, falar, declarar, ordenar

tokens.bdb: Jehoshua (i.e. Joshua), the Jewish leader
tokens.kjv: Jehoshua, Jehoshuah, Joshua. Compare H1954 (הוֹשֵׁעַ), H3442 (יֵשׁוּעַ).
tokens.explanation: Jehoshua

tokens.bdb: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive, intransitive, intensive, causative); specifically, to cover (in copulation)
tokens.kjv: alienate, alter, [idiom] at all, beyond, bring (over, through), carry over, (over-) come (on, over), conduct (over), convey over, current, deliver, do away, enter, escape, fail, gender, get over, (make) go (away, beyond, by, forth, his way, in, on, over, through), have away (more), lay, meddle, overrun, make partition, (cause to, give, make to, over) pass(-age, along, away, beyond, by, -enger, on, out, over, through), (cause to, make) [phrase] proclaim(-amation), perish, provoke to anger, put away, rage, [phrase] raiser of taxes, remove, send over, set apart, [phrase] shave, cause to (make) sound, [idiom] speedily, [idiom] sweet smelling, take (away), (make to) transgress(-or), translate, turn away, (way-) faring man, be wrath.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive
tokens.enLiteralWord: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive
tokens.explanation: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive
tokens.explanationEn: to cross over; used very widely of any transition (literal or figurative; transitive

tokens.bdb: the face (as the part that turns); used in a great variety of applications (literally and figuratively); also (with prepositional prefix) as a preposition (before, etc.)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] accept, a-(be-) fore(-time), against, anger, [idiom] as (long as), at, [phrase] battle, [phrase] because (of), [phrase] beseech, countenance, edge, [phrase] employ, endure, [phrase] enquire, face, favour, fear of, for, forefront(-part), form(-er time, -ward), from, front, heaviness, [idiom] him(-self), [phrase] honourable, [phrase] impudent, [phrase] in, it, look(-eth) (-s), [idiom] me, [phrase] meet, [idiom] more than, mouth, of, off, (of) old (time), [idiom] on, open, [phrase] out of, over against, the partial, person, [phrase] please, presence, propect, was purposed, by reason of, [phrase] regard, right forth, [phrase] serve, [idiom] shewbread, sight, state, straight, [phrase] street, [idiom] thee, [idiom] them(-selves), through ([phrase] -out), till, time(-s) past, (un-) to(-ward), [phrase] upon, upside ([phrase] down), with(-in, [phrase] -stand), [idiom] ye, [idiom] you.
tokens.enLiteralWord: the face ; used in a great variety of applications ; also  as a preposition (before
tokens.explanation: panim — face, presença, frente (sempre plural em hebraico)
tokens.explanationEn: the face ; used in a great variety of applications ; also  as a preposition (before

tokens.bdb: a box
tokens.kjv: ark, chest, coffin.
tokens.explanation: a box

tokens.bdb: Jehovah, Jewish national name of God
tokens.kjv: Jehovah, the Lord. Compare H3050 (יָהּ), H3069 (יְהֹוִה).
tokens.explanation: YHWH — Nome próprio de Deus revelado a Moisés. Tradição massorética lê "Adonai"

tokens.bdb: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus, especially with the article) of the supreme God; occasionally applied by way of deference to magistrates; and sometimes as a superlative
tokens.kjv: angels, [idiom] exceeding, God (gods) (-dess, -ly), [idiom] (very) great, judges, [idiom] mighty.
tokens.enLiteralWord: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus
tokens.explanation: Elohim — nome hebraico de Deus. Plural de majestade. Denota o único Deus verdadeiro
tokens.explanationEn: gods in the ordinary sense; but specifically used (in the plural thus

tokens.bdb: near, with or among; often in general, to
tokens.kjv: about, according to, after, against, among, as for, at, because(-fore, -side), both...and, by, concerning, for, from, [idiom] hath, in(-to), near, (out) of, over, through, to(-ward), under, unto, upon, whether, with(-in).
tokens.explanation: el — preposição de direção: a, para, em direção a

tokens.bdb: a bisection, i.e. (by implication) the centre
tokens.kjv: among(-st), [idiom] between, half, [idiom] (there-, where-), in(-to), middle, mid(-night), midst (among), [idiom] out (of), [idiom] through, [idiom] with(-in).
tokens.explanation: tavek — meio, centro, interior, entre

tokens.bdb: Jarden, the principal river of Palestine
tokens.kjv: Jordan.
tokens.explanation: Jarden

tokens.bdb: to be high actively, to rise or raise (in various applications, literally or figuratively)
tokens.kjv: bring up, exalt (self), extol, give, go up, haughty, heave (up), (be, lift up on, make on, set up on, too) high(-er, one), hold up, levy, lift(-er) up, (be) lofty, ([idiom] a-) loud, mount up, offer (up), [phrase] presumptuously, (be) promote(-ion), proud, set up, tall(-er), take (away, off, up), breed worms.
tokens.explanation: to be high actively

tokens.bdb: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term (and in such cases frequently not expressed in translation)
tokens.kjv: also, another, any (man), a certain, [phrase] champion, consent, each, every (one), fellow, (foot-, husband-) man, (good-, great, mighty) man, he, high (degree), him (that is), husband, man(-kind), [phrase] none, one, people, person, [phrase] steward, what (man) soever, whoso(-ever), worthy. Compare H802 (אִשָּׁה).
tokens.enLiteralWord: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term
tokens.explanation: ish — homem, varão, marido, indivíduo, alguém
tokens.explanationEn: a man as an individual or a male person; often used as an adjunct to a more definite term

tokens.bdb: a stone
tokens.kjv: [phrase] carbuncle, [phrase] mason, [phrase] plummet, (chalk-, hail-, head-, sling-) stone(-ny), (divers) weight(-s).
tokens.explanation: a stone

tokens.bdb: properly, united, i.e. one; or (as an ordinal) first
tokens.kjv: a, alike, alone, altogether, and, any(-thing), apiece, a certain, (dai-) ly, each (one), [phrase] eleven, every, few, first, [phrase] highway, a man, once, one, only, other, some, together,
tokens.explanation: echad — um, unido, o primeiro (numeral ordinal)

tokens.bdb: above, over, upon, or against (yet always in this last relation with a downward aspect) in a great variety of applications
tokens.kjv: above, according to(-ly), after, (as) against, among, and, [idiom] as, at, because of, beside (the rest of), between, beyond the time, [idiom] both and, by (reason of), [idiom] had the charge of, concerning for, in (that), (forth, out) of, (from) (off), (up-) on, over, than, through(-out), to, touching, [idiom] with.
tokens.explanation: al — sobre, acima, contra, em relação a

tokens.bdb: the neck (between the shoulders) as the place of burdens; figuratively, the spur of ahill
tokens.kjv: back, [idiom] consent, portion, shoulder.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: the neck  as the place of burdens; figuratively
tokens.enLiteralWord: the neck  as the place of burdens; figuratively
tokens.explanation: the neck  as the place of burdens; figuratively
tokens.explanationEn: the neck  as the place of burdens; figuratively

tokens.bdb: a number, definite (arithmetical) or indefinite (large, innumerable; small, a few); also (abstractly) narration
tokens.kjv: [phrase] abundance, account, [idiom] all, [idiom] few, (in-) finite, (certain) number(-ed), tale, telling, [phrase] time.
tokens.explanation: a number

tokens.bdb: a scion, i.e. (literally) a stick (for punishing, writing, fighting, ruling, walking, etc.) or (figuratively) a clan
tokens.kjv: [idiom] correction, dart, rod, sceptre, staff, tribe.
tokens.explanation: a scion

tokens.bdb: a son (as a builder of the family name), in the widest sense (of literal and figurative relationship, including grandson, subject, nation, quality or condition, etc., (like father or brother), etc.)
tokens.kjv: [phrase] afflicted, age, (Ahoh-) (Ammon-) (Hachmon-) (Lev-) ite, (anoint-) ed one, appointed to, ([phrase]) arrow, (Assyr-) (Babylon-) (Egypt-) (Grec-) ian, one born, bough, branch, breed, [phrase] (young) bullock, [phrase] (young) calf, [idiom] came up in, child, colt, [idiom] common, [idiom] corn, daughter, [idiom] of first, [phrase] firstborn, foal, [phrase] very fruitful, [phrase] postage, [idiom] in, [phrase] kid, [phrase] lamb, ([phrase]) man, meet, [phrase] mighty, [phrase] nephew, old, ([phrase]) people, [phrase] rebel, [phrase] robber, [idiom] servant born, [idiom] soldier, son, [phrase] spark, [phrase] steward, [phrase] stranger, [idiom] surely, them of, [phrase] tumultuous one, [phrase] valiant(-est), whelp, worthy, young (one), youth.
tokens.explanation: ben — filho, descendente, membro de um grupo (bar em aramaico)

tokens.bdb: Jisrael, a symbolical name of Jacob; also (typically) of his posterity
tokens.kjv: Israel.
tokens.explanation: Yisrael — nome dado a Jacó (aquele que luta com Deus)
